dogecoin.text:
I hope #dogecoin reaches $10 so I can't watch all those who didn't buy in be confused and cry at our reality.

Then i want #doge to plummet to $0 so I can watch the same thing on the other side.

Delicious.
How do I #NFT a #dogecoin and make it #ToTheMOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOON before @stoolpresidente ruins everything we've built with his boomer humor?

Everyone new to #investing especially in #crypto  #Bitcoin  and #dogecoin let me give you the best advice I ever learned in business. 

You make your money when you buy. 

Some are dying right now, some are sitting pretty. The only difference? Entry point.

@ProTheDoge #bitcoin & #dogecoin do not share value propositions. You can't compare the response to the price action because of that.

To do so shows a lack of understanding of both coins.
